proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ t i j k hij hik hjk
  have hu : ∀ (l m n : Fin 3), l ≠ m → l ≠ n → m ≠ n → (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)) = {l, m, n} := by decide
  have hall : ∀ l : Fin 3, l = i ∨ l = j ∨ l = k := by decide +revert
  have med : ∀ l m n : Fin 3, l ≠ m → l ≠ n → m ≠ n → 9 * dist (t.points l) t.centroid ^ 2 =
      2 * dist (t.points l) (t.points m) ^ 2 + 2 * dist (t.points l) (t.points n) ^ 2 - dist (t.points m) (t.points n) ^ 2 := by
    intro l m n hlm hln hmn
    have h0 : (t.points l -ᵥ t.centroid) + (t.points m -ᵥ t.centroid) + (t.points n -ᵥ t.centroid) = (0 : V) := by
      have h := Affine.Simplex.eq_centroid_iff_sum_vsub_eq_zero.mp (rfl : t.centroid = t.centroid)
      rwa [hu l m n hlm hln hmn, Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hlm, hln]), Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hmn]), Finset.sum_singleton, ← add_assoc] at h
    have d : ∀ x y : P, dist x y ^ 2 = ‖x -ᵥ t.centroid‖ ^ 2 - 2 * inner ℝ (x -ᵥ t.centroid) (y -ᵥ t.centroid) + ‖y -ᵥ t.centroid‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro x y
      rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V x y, ← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right x y t.centroid, norm_sub_sq_real]
    rw [d (t.points l) (t.points m), d (t.points l) (t.points n), d (t.points m) (t.points n), dist_eq_norm_vsub V (t.points l) t.centroid]
    generalize t.points l -ᵥ t.centroid = a at *
    generalize t.points m -ᵥ t.centroid = b at *
    generalize t.points n -ᵥ t.centroid = c at *
    have hc : c = -(a + b) := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h0
    subst hc
    simp only [inner_neg_right, inner_add_right, norm_neg]
    have e : ‖a + b‖ ^ 2 = ‖a‖ ^ 2 + 2 * inner ℝ a b + ‖b‖ ^ 2 := norm_add_sq_real a b
    rw [e, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, real_inner_comm a b]
    ring
  have mi := med i j k hij hik hjk
  have mj := med j k i hjk hij.symm hik.symm
  have mk := med k i j hik.symm hjk.symm hij
  rw [dist_comm (t.points j) (t.points i)] at mj
  rw [dist_comm (t.points k) (t.points i)] at mj mk
  rw [dist_comm (t.points k) (t.points j)] at mk
  rw [dist_comm (t.points k) (t.points i)]
  constructor
  · intro hGO
    rw [hGO, t.dist_circumcenter_eq_circumradius] at mi mj mk
    constructor
    · rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ dist_nonneg dist_nonneg]; linarith
    · rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ dist_nonneg dist_nonneg]; linarith
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    rw [← h2, ← h1] at mi mj mk
    have ej : dist (t.points j) t.centroid = dist (t.points i) t.centroid := by
      rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ dist_nonneg dist_nonneg]; linarith
    have ek : dist (t.points k) t.centroid = dist (t.points i) t.centroid := by
      rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ dist_nonneg dist_nonneg]; linarith
    refine t.eq_circumcenter_of_dist_eq t.centroid_mem_affineSpan (r := dist (t.points i) t.centroid) fun l => ?_
    rcases hall l with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · rfl
    · exact ej
    · exact ek
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (t : Affine.Triangle ℝ P) (i j k : Fin 3), i ≠ j → i ≠ k → j ≠ k → (t.centroid = t.circumcenter ↔ dist (t.points i) (t.points j) = dist (t.points j) (t.points k) ∧ dist (t.points j) (t.points k) = dist (t.points k) (t.points i))
